# Ravi Raj

## About

Personal homepage of Ravi Raj. "Dualities" is a collection of my unapologetic thoughts on politics, law, and lies..

## Posts

- [Why race to backwardness is India's biggest nightmare?](https://raviraj.dpdns.org/p/why-race-to-backwardness-is-india-s-biggest-nightmare/): Being more weak in India is a super power. The weaker you show yourself, the more the government will try to empower you.
